tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['OUPUT']
src = wb['INPUT']
map = {'UNATIDE STATES AMERICAN':'USA','FRANCE':'FRA','KOREA':'KOR','GERMANY':'GR','ITALY':'IT'}
for r in range(2,7):
    if src.cell(r,1).value is None:
        continue
    ws.cell(r,1).value = src.cell(r,1).value
    ws.cell(r,2).value = src.cell(r,3).value
    ws.cell(r,3).value = src.cell(r,5).value
    ws.cell(r,4).value = map[src.cell(r,6).value]
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
